beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposal therefore needs privacy, explanation, correction, and credible independence from commercial capture.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It is a governance problem inside a technical assistant, not a promise of automatic wisdom.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This example shows why the book connects personal tools with institutional design.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Communication architecture offers another sample of the same underlying approach.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Humanly usable addresses can remain distinct from the providers carrying a conversation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A bounded introduction step checks a proposed connection before exposing more expensive private services.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book explores this through existing protocol ideas and explicit consent.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Relays, identifiers, signaling, and introduction services still carry costs and attack risks.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reducing exposure therefore does not mean eliminating abuse or making every connection private.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The architecture matters because it gives the governance argument a concrete technical test.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These proposals belong together through a redistribution of authority, rather than decentralization for its own sake.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Local communities need room for different purposes, while shared standards address wider harms.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A custodian must protect the common name without becoming its unrestricted owner.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A personal agent must serve its user without sealing that person inside comfortable confirmation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A communication gate must reduce exposure without pretending that infrastructure has disappeared.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book’s distinctive invitation is to examine these tensions as connected design responsibilities.
